objects.description: [Qilin](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1242) has created a RunOnce autostart entry at `HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce*aster = %Public%\enc.exe` pointing to a dropped copy of itself in the Public folder.(Citation: Trend Micro Agenda Ransomware AUG 2022)(Citation: Halcyon Qilin.B OCT 2024)(Citation: Cisco Talos Qilin Ransomware OCT 2025)
objects.description_fa: [Qilin](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1242) یک ورودی RunOnce برای شروع خودکار در «HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce*aster = %Public%\enc.exe کپی خود را در یک نسخه عمومی ایجاد کرده است. پوشه.(Citation: Trend Micro Agenda Ransomware AUG 2022)(Citation: Halcyon Qilin.B OCT 2024)(Citation: Cisco Talos Qilin Ransomware OCT 2025)
